info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Investment Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Analysis API allows users to retrieve detailed insights on investment management portfolios based on specific parameters. This endpoint is designed for financial analysts, portfolio managers, or decision-makers looking to assess investment performance and strategies. By providing parameterized queries, it enables targeted analysis that supports informed investment decisions. Use cases include performance tracking, risk assessment, and portfolio optimization.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed analysis data for a specific investment portfolio, identified by its unique resource ID. It provides insights into the performance, risks, and opportunities associated with the portfolio.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the investment portfolio analysis. It should contain all the necessary parameters to perform the analysis effectively.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the investment portfolio analysis data.

GetInvestmentManagementByParam1Request.description: A request body for the investment portfolio analysis operation, providing details necessary for processing the request.

GetInvestmentManagementByParam1Response_.title: Investment Portfolio Analysis Response

investmentAccountId.description: Unique identifier for the investment account associated with the portfolio.

investmentObjective.description: The primary investment objective of the portfolio.

riskProfile.description: The risk profile associated with the portfolio.

baseCurrency.description: The base currency used for the portfolio's financial transactions.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the portfolio record.

version.description: Version number for the portfolio data.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the portfolio was last updated.

GetInvestmentManagementByParam1Response_.description: This schema represents the response for the investment portfolio analysis operation.
